capabilities: Tap customizable toolbar buttons to run any Obsidian or community-plugin command
Detach the toolbar and flick in eight directions to launch assigned commands
Flick the handle down to hide the keyboard while keeping the toolbar docked
Reorder, remove, and restyle buttons with custom icons
Wrap selected text in [[|selected text]] via an Insert alias command
extras: Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; verified on iPhone (version 0.1.20) while Android is untested; requires Obsidian 1.13.7+; MPL 2.0 license; desktop use is possible via a Show on desktop setting with mouse or trackpad.
problem: Obsidian's mobile interface offers no quick, customizable way to run commands or hide the keyboard without leaving the editing view.
summary: Configurable mobile toolbar with customizable command buttons that detaches into a floating eight-direction gesture pad for launching commands.
